entries.template: A committee of {committeeSize} is to be selected from {totalObjects} people. In how many ways can it be formed if one particular person must be included?
A team of {committeeSize} is chosen from {totalObjects} players. How many teams are possible if two particular players must both be selected?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {totalObjects} people. In how many ways can it be formed if one particular person cannot be selected?
A panel of {committeeSize} is chosen from {totalObjects} candidates. How many panels are possible if two particular candidates are both excluded?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {totalObjects} people. Person A must be included and person B must be excluded. How many committees are possible?
A committee of {committeeSize} is formed from {categoryA} women and {categoryB} men. In how many ways can exactly {requiredFromA} women be selected?
A committee of {committeeSize} is formed from {categoryA} teachers and {categoryB} students. In how many ways can equal numbers of teachers and students be selected?
A committee of {committeeSize} is formed from {categoryA} women and {categoryB} men. In how many ways can women form a strict majority of the committee?
A project group of {committeeSize} is selected from {categoryA} engineers and {categoryB} analysts. How many groups contain at least {minimumFromA} engineers?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {categoryA} senior officers and {categoryB} junior officers. How many committees contain at most {maximumFromA} senior officers?
A committee of {committeeSize} is formed from {categoryA} women and {categoryB} men. In how many ways can the committee contain at least one woman?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {categoryA} members of Department A and {categoryB} members of Department B. How many committees contain at least one member from each department?

A committee is formed from {categoryA} teachers, {categoryB} clerks and {categoryC} officers. In how many ways can exactly {requiredA} teachers, {requiredB} clerks and {requiredC} officers be selected?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {categoryA} teachers, {categoryB} clerks and {categoryC} officers. How many committees contain at least one member from each category?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {totalObjects} people. In how many ways can exactly one of A and B be selected?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {totalObjects} people. In how many ways can at least one of the two particular people A and B be selected?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {totalObjects} people. A and B cannot both be members of the committee. How many committees are possible?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {totalObjects} people. A and B must either both be selected or both be left out. How many committees are possible?
A committee of {committeeSize} is selected from {totalObjects} people. If B is selected, A must also be selected. How many committees satisfy this condition?
Among {totalObjects} people, {specifiedCount} are specially identified. How many committees of {committeeSize} contain at most {maximumSpecified} of those identified people?
Among {totalObjects} people, {specifiedCount} are specially identified. How many committees of {committeeSize} contain exactly {requiredSpecified} of those identified people?

A committee of {committeeSize} is formed from {categoryA} women and {categoryB} men. One particular woman must be selected, and the committee must contain exactly {requiredFromA} women in all. How many committees are possible?

A committee of {committeeSize} is formed from {categoryA} men and {categoryB} women. One particular man is unavailable, and the committee must contain exactly {requiredFromA} men. How many committees are possible?
A committee of {committeeSize} must include one particular person. If it can be formed in {target} ways from a group of \(n\) people, find \(n\), where \({searchMinimum} \le n \le {searchMaximum}\).

A committee of {committeeSize} is formed from \(a\) members of Category A and {categoryB} members of Category B, with exactly {requiredFromA} members chosen from Category A. If the committee can be formed in {target} ways, find \(a\), where \({searchMinimum} \le a \le {searchMaximum}\).
